definitions.text: brukt for å uttrykke at en er likeglad eller at noe er lite viktig
definitions.translation: used to express that one does not care or that something is of little importance

examples.no: men pytt sann, dette kan skje den beste
examples.en: but oh well, this can happen to the best of us

examples.no: pytt sann, det var verdt forsøket
examples.en: oh well, it was worth a try
